text_block_list.text:
With the distant roar of the crowd
pushing her
forward, Матиканэфукукитару
dominates the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Матиканэфукукитару who relied
purely on luck
is no more. Almost
fainting with elation over her
new
accomplishment, she heads to the
winner's
interview...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Where she tells the spectators that
happiness
comes to those who seek it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She follows that with a grand
announcement that
she will continue to
run for her fans, promising to
bring them
happiness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
